source.caption: Rank correspondence between univariate effect size (| d |) and model-based importance in the Big5 and 16PF. Scatter plots show Spearman rank correlations between absolute Cohen’s d and aggregated feature-importance rankings derived from SHAP and permutation importance for (A) Big5 and (B) 16PF. The dashed line denotes the identity line (perfect rank agreement).
